# Hatha Yogashala — Yoga School in Goa, India

> Hatha Yogashala is a Yoga Alliance-registered yoga school and ashram in Querim, North Goa, offering residential 100, 200, and 300-hour Hatha yoga teacher training and 3–10 day restorative yoga retreats near Querim and Arambol beaches.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://www.hathayogashala.com/) — Yoga school overview, courses, retreats, and student reviews
- [About](https://www.hathayogashala.com/about) — School philosophy, history, and Yoga Alliance registration
- [200-Hour Yoga Teacher Training](https://www.hathayogashala.com/courses/200-hour-yoga-teacher-training-goa) — Flagship certification course
- [100-Hour Yoga Teacher Training](https://www.hathayogashala.com/courses/100-hour-yoga-teacher-training-goa) — Foundation course for beginners
- [300-Hour Yoga Teacher Training](https://www.hathayogashala.com/courses/300-hour-yoga-teacher-training-goa) — Advanced training for certified teachers
- [Yoga Retreats](https://www.hathayogashala.com/retreats) — 3, 5, 7, and 10-day wellness retreats
- [Teachers](https://www.hathayogashala.com/teachers) — Faculty and teaching team
- [Accommodation](https://www.hathayogashala.com/accommodation) — Rooms, meals, and campus facilities
- [Pricing](https://www.hathayogashala.com/pricing) — Transparent course fees and dates
- [Gallery](https://www.hathayogashala.com/gallery) — Photos of practice, campus, and Goa surroundings
- [Blog](https://www.hathayogashala.com/blog) — Guides to yoga study, teacher training, and Goa travel
- [Contact](https://www.hathayogashala.com/contact) — Enquiry form, WhatsApp, and directions
- [Apply](https://www.hathayogashala.com/apply) — Application form for courses and retreats

## Location

Querim, Pernem, North Goa, India — near Querim and Arambol beaches, approximately 30 minutes from Mopa International Airport (GOX).
